blocks.text: O'zlashtirma gap: birovning so'zini qayta yetkazish

Ko'chirma gap — so'zning aynan o'zi: Bekzod said, "I'm tired." O'zlashtirma gap (reported speech) — mazmunni o'z so'zimiz bilan yetkazish: Bekzod **said** he **was** tired. Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 50-dars), bu darsda — to'liq zamonlar tizimi, olmosh, vaqt va joy so'zlarining o'zgarishi, say / tell farqi va boshqa «aytish» fe'llari.

O'zbekchada o'zlashtirma gap sifatdosh bilan quriladi: Bekzod charcha**ganini** aytdi, ishla**yotganini** aytdi, kel**ishini** aytdi. Bu shakllar o'z-o'zidan «o'sha paytga nisbatan» ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun zamon o'zgarmaydi. Ingliz tilida esa fe'l **bir pog'ona orqaga** suriladi (backshift): so'z o'tmishda aytilgan, biz esa hozirdan turib gapiryapmiz. «I'm tired» deyilgan payt allaqachon o'tmish — demak, he **was** tired.

rows: "I don't know." → He said he **didn't know**.
"I lost it." → He said he **had lost** it.
"I must go." → He said he **had to** go.
would, could, should, might, had done
"You should rest." → He said I **should** rest.

items.text: Bekzod **said** he **was** completely exhausted after the trip.
items.translation: Bekzod safardan keyin butunlay **holdan toyganini aytdi**.

items.text: They **said** they **had sold** their house in the village.
Madina **said** she **would** help me with the presentation.

blocks.text: Olmosh, vaqt va joy ham o'zgaradi

Gapiruvchi o'zgargani uchun olmoshlar ham o'zgaradi: Tom said, "**I** love **my** job" → Tom said **he** loved **his** job. Agar so'z boshqa kuni va boshqa joyda yetkazilsa, vaqt va joy so'zlari ham moslashadi. Lekin bu mexanik qoida emas: agar hali o'sha kun va o'sha joy bo'lsa, «today», «here» o'zgarmaydi. Mantiq bilan tekshiring: «Bu so'z men gapirayotgan paytda hali ham to'g'rimi?»

items.text: On Friday Aziz **said** he **would** finish the report **the next day**.
items.translation: Juma kuni Aziz hisobotni **ertasi kuni** tugatishini aytdi.

items.text: Emma **told** me she **had** arrived **there** two days **before**.
items.translation: Emma u yerga **ikki kun oldin** kelganini aytdi.

items.text: Jasur **said** he **had** seen **that** film **the week before**.
items.translation: Jasur **o'sha** filmni **bir hafta oldin** ko'rganini aytdi.

blocks.text: O'zbekchadagi «aytmoq» inglizchada ikki fe'lga bo'linadi va eng ko'p xato shu yerda. **tell** dan keyin **odam** keladi: tell **me**, told **Sarah**, tell **them** — kimga aytilgani albatta ko'rsatiladi. **say** dan keyin odam kelmaydi; agar kerak bo'lsa — **to** bilan: She **said** (**to me**) that ... «She said me» va «She told that» — ikkalasi ham xato. Ba'zi turg'un iboralar faqat bittasi bilan: **tell** the truth, **tell** a lie, **tell** a story, **tell** a joke, **tell** the difference; **say** hello / goodbye, **say** sorry, **say** a word.

rows: She **said to me** that she was busy.
He **told** the truth / a lie / a joke.

items.text: Sarah **said to** her colleagues that she was going on holiday.
Sarah **told** her colleagues she was going on holiday.
Jasur never **tells** lies, so I believe him.
items.translation: Jasur hech qachon **yolg'on gapirmaydi**, shuning uchun unga ishonaman.

blocks.text: So'zlashuvda **that** ko'pincha tushib qoladi: He said (**that**) he was tired. Rasmiy yozuvda esa u saqlanadi. say va tell dan tashqari mazmunni aniqroq ko'rsatadigan fe'llar ham bor: **explain** (tushuntirdi), **mention** (aytib o'tdi), **admit** (tan oldi), **complain** (shikoyat qildi), **reply** (javob berdi), **promise** (va'da berdi), **warn** (ogohlantirdi), **announce** (e'lon qildi), **insist** (qat'iy turib oldi). Ular ham that + backshift bilan ishlatiladi. Diqqat: **explain** dan keyin odam to bilan keladi — explained **to me** that ... («explained me» ✗).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He said me that ...» → He **told me** / He **said to me** that ...; «She told that she was ill» → She **said** that ... / She **told us** that ...; «Tom said he is tired yesterday» → Tom said he **was** tired (o'zbekchadagi «charchaganini aytdi» da zamon yo'q, inglizchada backshift kerak); «He said that I will call you» → He said **he would** call **me** (olmoshlar ham o'zgaradi); «explained me» → explained **to me**.

Uch qadam: 1) **Olmosh** — kim kim haqida gapiryapti? (I → he, my → his). 2) **Zamon** — bir pog'ona orqaga (is → was, has done → had done, will → would). 3) **Vaqt va joy** — hali ham o'sha kunmi, o'sha joymi? Bo'lmasa: tomorrow → the next day, here → there.

rows: Perfekt va o'tgan zamon → Past Perfect
"I've seen it / I saw it." → She said she **had seen** it.
will / can / may / must → would / could / might / had to
"I'll do it tomorrow." → She said **she** would do it **the next day**.
Boshqa fe'llar: explain, admit, complain, promise ...
She **admitted** that she **had** made a mistake.

examples.title: **said** he **was** ...: am / is / are, do → did
examples.description: Hozirgi zamon o'tgan zamonga suriladi: am / is / are → was / were, like / know / live → liked / knew / lived, don't → didn't.

sentences.text: Aziz **said** he **was** too tired to go to the gym after work.
sentences.translation: Aziz ishdan keyin sport zaliga borishga juda **charchaganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Emma **told** me that her new flat **was** much bigger than the old one.
sentences.translation: Emma yangi kvartirasi eskisidan ancha **kattaligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: The doctor **said** my test results **were** completely normal.
sentences.translation: Shifokor tahlil natijalarim mutlaqo **normal ekanini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **said** he **didn't like** working at weekends, but he needed the money.
sentences.translation: Jasur dam olish kunlari ishlashni **yoqtirmasligini aytdi**, lekin unga pul kerak edi.

sentences.text: When I met Kate in the summer, she **said** she **lived** in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Yozda Keyt bilan uchrashganimda, u Oksfordda **yashashini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **told** us that the exam **was** on the twelfth of June.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz imtihon 12-iyunda **bo'lishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Everyone **said** the film **was** boring, so we didn't go.
sentences.translation: Hamma film **zerikarli ekanini aytdi**, shuning uchun bormadik.

sentences.text: My grandfather always **said** that hard work **was** more important than talent.
sentences.translation: Bobom doim mehnat iste'doddan **muhimroq ekanini aytardi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **said** he **knew** a good mechanic who could fix my car cheaply.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinamni arzonga tuzatib beradigan yaxshi **ustani bilishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: The receptionist **said** all the rooms **were** booked, but one suite **was** still free.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi barcha xonalar **band ekanini**, lekin bitta lyuks xona hali **bo'shligini aytdi**.

examples.title: **was doing**, **had done**: continuous and perfect
examples.description: am doing → was doing, have done → had done, did → had done. O'zbekchada: qidirayotganini, ko'rganini aytdi.

sentences.text: Madina **said** she **was looking** for a cheaper flat closer to the university.
sentences.translation: Madina universitetga yaqinroq, arzonroq kvartira **qidirayotganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **told** me he **had** never **been** to Scotland, even though he lived in England.
sentences.translation: Tom Angliyada yashasa ham, Shotlandiyada hech **bo'lmaganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: The manager **said** they **were** still **checking** my application.
sentences.translation: Menejer arizamni hali ham **tekshirayotganlarini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **said** she **had** already **seen** the film twice.
sentences.translation: Nilufar filmni allaqachon ikki marta **ko'rganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: When I phoned, Oliver **said** he **was having** dinner and would call me back.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda, Oliver **kechki ovqat qilayotganini** va keyin qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

sentences.text: James **said** he **had lost** his phone on the way to work.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ishga kelayotganda telefonini **yo'qotib qo'yganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: They **told** us the hotel **had been** renovated recently.
sentences.translation: Ular mehmonxona yaqinda **ta'mirlanganini aytishdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **said** she **had met** her husband at university in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza turmush o'rtog'i bilan Toshkentda universitetda **tanishganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Everybody was surprised when Sarah **said** she **was leaving** the company.
sentences.translation: Sara kompaniyadan **ketayotganini aytganida** hamma hayron bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **said** the train **had** already **left** by the time he reached the station.
sentences.translation: Bekzod vokzalga yetib borganida poyezd allaqachon **jo'nab ketganini aytdi**.

examples.title: **would**, **could**, **might**, **had to**: modals
examples.description: will → would, can → could, may → might, must → had to. would, could, should, might o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.text: Kate **said** she **would** call me as soon as she landed in London.
sentences.translation: Keyt Londonga qo'nishi bilanoq menga **qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: The mechanic **told** us he **couldn't** repair the car until Monday.
sentences.translation: Usta mashinani dushanbagacha **tuzata olmasligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **said** he **might** be a bit late because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Jasur tirbandlik sababli biroz **kechikishi mumkinligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: At the border, the officer **told** me I **had to** show my passport again.
sentences.translation: Chegarada xodim pasportimni yana **ko'rsatishim kerakligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **promised** that he **would** never be late again.
sentences.translation: Aziz boshqa hech qachon **kechikmaslikka va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: My parents **said** I **could** use their car while they were away.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam ular yo'qligida mashinalaridan **foydalanishim mumkinligini aytishdi**.

sentences.text: The weather forecast **said** it **would** snow in the mountains at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotida dam olish kunlari tog'larda qor **yog'ishi aytildi**.

sentences.text: Madina **said** she **wouldn't** be able to come to the party.
sentences.translation: Madina ziyofatga **kela olmasligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Our professor **said** we **should** read the first three chapters before Monday.
sentences.translation: Professorimiz dushanbagacha birinchi uch bobni **o'qishimiz kerakligini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **told** me he **could** speak a little Uzbek because his mother was from Fergana.
sentences.translation: Oliver onasi farg'onalik bo'lgani uchun ozroq **o'zbekcha gapira olishini aytdi**.

examples.title: Pronouns, time and place: **the next day**, **there**
examples.description: So'z boshqa vaqtda va joyda yetkazilsa: I → he, my → his, tomorrow → the next day, ago → before, here → there, this → that.

sentences.text: On Monday Kate **said** she **would** see me **the next day**, but she didn't come.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni Keyt meni **ertasi kuni** ko'rishini aytdi, lekin kelmadi.

sentences.text: Aziz **told** us he **had** bought his car three years **before**.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashinasini **o'shandan uch yil oldin** sotib olganini aytdi.

sentences.text: The guide **said** we could take photos **there**, but not inside the mosque.
sentences.translation: Gid **u yerda** suratga olishimiz mumkinligini, lekin masjid ichida mumkin emasligini aytdi.

sentences.text: When I spoke to Madina last month, she **said** she **was** starting a new job **the following week**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy Madina bilan gaplashganimda, u **keyingi haftada** yangi ishni boshlashini aytdi.

sentences.text: Emma **said** she **had** finished the report **the day before**, but I still haven't received it.
sentences.translation: Emma hisobotni **bir kun oldin** tugatganini aytdi, lekin men uni hali ham olmadim.

sentences.text: The salesman **said** **that** model **was** the best on the market.
sentences.translation: Sotuvchi **o'sha** model bozordagi eng yaxshisi ekanini aytdi.

sentences.text: Jasur **told** me he **was** busy **that day**, so we met on Saturday instead.
sentences.translation: Jasur **o'sha kuni** bandligini aytdi, shuning uchun o'rniga shanba kuni uchrashdik.

sentences.text: My brother called and said **he had left his** keys at **my** place.
sentences.translation: Akam qo'ng'iroq qilib, **kalitlarini menikida** qoldirganini aytdi.

sentences.text: At the time, Nilufar **said** she **didn't** want children, but now she has three.
sentences.translation: O'sha paytda Nilufar farzand **xohlamasligini aytgan edi**, endi esa uchta farzandi bor.

sentences.text: Last summer Tom **told** me he **had** given up smoking **two months earlier**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Tom **ikki oy oldin** chekishni tashlaganini aytdi.

examples.title: **say** or **tell**?
examples.description: tell + odam (tell me, told Sarah), say + (to + odam). Turg'un iboralar: tell the truth / a joke / a story, say goodbye / sorry / a word.

sentences.text: Kate **told** me she was pregnant before she **told** her parents.
sentences.translation: Keyt homiladorligini ota-onasiga **aytishdan** oldin menga **aytdi**.

sentences.text: What **did** the doctor **say** about your knee? — He **said** it wasn't serious.
sentences.translation: Shifokor tizzangiz haqida nima **dedi**? — Jiddiy emasligini **aytdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **said** goodbye to everyone and left without **telling** anyone where he was going.
sentences.translation: Bekzod hamma bilan **xayrlashdi** va qayerga ketayotganini hech kimga **aytmasdan** chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: Why didn't you **tell** me that the meeting was cancelled?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish bekor qilinganini menga nega **aytmading**?

sentences.text: Children should always **tell** the truth, even when it's difficult.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qiyin bo'lsa ham doim **rostini aytishi** kerak.

sentences.text: Madina **said to** her colleagues that she was going to resign.
sentences.translation: Madina hamkasblariga ishdan **ketmoqchi ekanini aytdi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather loves **telling** stories about his years in the army.
sentences.translation: Bobom armiyadagi yillari haqida **hikoya qilib berishni** yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Can you **tell** the difference between these two photos?
sentences.translation: Bu ikki surat orasidagi farqni **ajrata olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Nobody **said** a word when the director announced the bad news.
sentences.translation: Direktor yomon xabarni e'lon qilganda hech kim **churq etmadi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **told** a joke, but nobody laughed, so he **said** sorry and sat down.
sentences.translation: Oliver **latifa aytdi**, lekin hech kim kulmadi, shuning uchun u **uzr so'rab** joyiga o'tirdi.

examples.title: Other verbs: **admitted**, **complained**, **explained**
examples.description: say o'rniga mazmunni aniqroq beradigan fe'llar: admit, complain, explain, mention, reply, announce, warn, insist, agree, promise + that.

sentences.text: Jasur **admitted** that he **had** forgotten to lock the door.
sentences.translation: Jasur eshikni qulflashni **unutganini tan oldi**.

sentences.text: Emma **complained** that the hotel room **was** too noisy to sleep in.
sentences.translation: Emma mehmonxona xonasi uxlab bo'lmaydigan darajada **shovqinli ekanidan shikoyat qildi**.

sentences.text: The teacher **explained** that the test **would** only take forty minutes.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi test bor-yo'g'i qirq daqiqa **davom etishini tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **mentioned** that she **was** thinking of moving to Manchester.
sentences.translation: Sara Manchesterga ko'chishni **o'ylayotganini aytib o'tdi**.

sentences.text: When I asked about the money, he **replied** that he **had** already **paid** it.
sentences.translation: Pul haqida so'raganimda, u allaqachon **to'lab qo'yganini javob qildi**.

sentences.text: The company **announced** that it **was** opening a new office in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya Samarqandda yangi ofis **ochayotganini e'lon qildi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **warned** us that the road **was** icy near the mountain pass.
sentences.translation: Aziz dovon yaqinida yo'l **muzlaganidan ogohlantirdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **insisted** that he **hadn't** taken the money from the drawer.
sentences.translation: Bekzod pulni tortmadan **olmaganini qat'iy ta'kidladi**.

sentences.text: My boss **agreed** that the deadline **was** unrealistic.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im muddat **real emasligiga qo'shildi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **promised** that she **would** pay me back by the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza qarzini oy oxirigacha **qaytarishga va'da berdi**.

examples.title: Passing on messages at work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ishxonada boshqalarning gapini yetkazish — bir gapda bir nechta surilgan fe'l.

sentences.text: Your sister phoned — she **said** she **was** stuck at the airport and **would** call later.
sentences.translation: Opangiz qo'ng'iroq qildi — aeroportda **qolib ketganini** va keyinroq **qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: James rang to **say** that the delivery **had been** delayed until Thursday.
sentences.translation: Jeyms qo'ng'iroq qilib, yetkazib berish payshanbagacha **kechiktirilganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: The client **told** us she **wasn't** happy with the design and **wanted** some changes.
sentences.translation: Mijoz dizayndan **norozi ekanini** va ba'zi o'zgarishlar **xohlashini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Madina left a message **saying** she **couldn't** come because her son **was** ill.
sentences.translation: Madina o'g'li kasal bo'lgani uchun **kela olmasligini** aytib xabar qoldirdi.

sentences.text: Kate **said** the printer on the second floor **had broken** down again.
sentences.translation: Keyt ikkinchi qavatdagi printer yana **buzilganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **said** he **had** sent the files the day before, but they never arrived.
sentences.translation: Oliver fayllarni bir kun oldin **yuborganini aytdi**, lekin ular hech qachon yetib kelmadi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **told** the boss that she **had been** working on the report all weekend.
sentences.translation: Nilufar boshliqqa butun dam olish kunlari hisobot ustida **ishlaganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Somebody from the bank **said** my new card **would** arrive within a week.
sentences.translation: Bankdan kimdir yangi kartam bir hafta ichida **kelishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **explained** that he **was** late because his car **wouldn't** start.
sentences.translation: Jasur mashinasi **o't olmagani** uchun **kechikkanini tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: In his speech, the director **said** the company **had had** its best year and everyone **would** get a bonus.
sentences.translation: Direktor nutqida kompaniya o'zining eng yaxshi yilini **o'tkazganini** va hamma mukofot **olishini aytdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: what did the doctor say?
examples.description: Ikki do'st suhbati: biri shifokor nima deganini yetkazadi — said, told, backshift va olmosh o'zgarishi.

sentences.text: — So, how was your appointment? What **did** the doctor **say**?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, qabul qanday o'tdi? Shifokor nima **dedi**?

sentences.text: — She **said** my blood pressure **was** a bit high but nothing serious.
sentences.translation: — Qon bosimim biroz **yuqoriligini**, lekin jiddiy emasligini **aytdi**.

sentences.text: — That's a relief. **Did** she **say** why it **was** high?
sentences.translation: — Yengil tortdim. Nega **yuqoriligini aytdimi**?

sentences.text: — She **said** I **was working** too much and **wasn't sleeping** enough.
sentences.translation: — Juda ko'p **ishlayotganimni** va yetarlicha **uxlamayotganimni aytdi**.

sentences.text: — I **told** you that a hundred times last month!
sentences.translation: — O'tgan oy senga buni yuz marta **aytgandim**-ku!

sentences.text: — I know. She also **said** she **would** send the test results by email.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Tahlil natijalarini elektron pochta orqali **yuborishini** ham **aytdi**.

sentences.text: — Good. And what **did** you **tell** her about your headaches?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Bosh og'riqlaring haqida unga nima **deding**?

sentences.text: — I **told** her they **had started** after I changed jobs.
sentences.translation: — Ular ish almashtirganimdan keyin **boshlanganini aytdim**.

sentences.text: — And did she **say** you **could** still play football?
sentences.translation: — Hali ham futbol **o'ynashing mumkinligini aytdimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, she **said** some exercise **would** actually help me relax.
sentences.translation: — Ha, biroz jismoniy mashq aslida **dam olishimga yordam berishini aytdi**.
